title: Xdrip with big diferences from finger BG + Treatments on NightScout
symptom: The user reports large differences between Libre readings via Blucon and fingerstick BG measurements, and that treatments entered in xDrip do not appear in NightScout reports, while those entered via AndroidAPS are identified.
fix: The user reinstalled xDrip, imported the database and initial settings backup, after which it worked great. No specific root cause was identified.
evidence_quote: Yesterday, i reinstall Xdrip, import Database and import the inicial settings backup that i have when i change to the Samsung. At the moment is working great!
